seoTitle: HTML Link Auditor: Empty Links, Broken Anchors, nofollow, Anchor Text
metaDescription: Paste page HTML and audit every link offline: empty and javascript hrefs, fragments with no target, http on https, _blank rel, nofollow and generic anchors.
intro: Audit all links in a page you paste: broken fragments, empty hrefs, insecure links, rel attributes and weak anchor text.
why:
Link problems hide in plain sight: href="#", javascript: URLs, anchors to ids that no longer exist, http links on https pages, target=_blank without rel, sponsored links without rel, and anchor text such as "click here". This auditor parses the pasted HTML, lists each finding with a severity, counts external, nofollow, sponsored and ugc links, flags repeated identical links and groups external domains.

A web page cannot fetch other sites, so it cannot tell whether a target returns 404; that part needs a crawler or the browser extension. Fragment checks only see ids present in the pasted HTML, so paste the whole page. Set the page URL to resolve relative links.
howTo: Paste the page HTML (View source or DevTools > Copy outerHTML).
Set the page URL so relative links resolve and internal/external is detected.
Fix the errors first, then warnings.

faq.q: Does it check whether links return 404?
faq.a: No. Requests to other sites are blocked for web pages. Use a crawler for status codes.
Empty hrefs, javascript: URLs and fragment links with no matching id in the pasted HTML.

faq.q: Is generic anchor text a real problem?
faq.a: It weakens context for users, screen readers and search engines; descriptive anchors are better.
